name: Optery
summary: Personal data removal service that scans people-search sites and data brokers for your name and address and files opt-out requests, from a free self-service report to managed removals with a human agent.
best_for: people in the US who want their home address and phone number off people-search sites, from a free self-service scan up to a managed service with a human agent
skip_if: you only have one current address and are willing to file opt-outs yourself with the free report, or you need protection outside the countries Optery serves
honest_knock: Core automates removals for one name and one city and state only, with no human handling exceptions; past addresses and name variations need Extended at $12.42 a month yearly. The advertised site counts assume Expanded Reach is enabled; without it Core covers 150+ sites instead of 380+. Custom removal requests on Ultimate only start after 30 days. Removals from data brokers take time and listings can reappear, which is why every paid plan rescans monthly. We have not used Optery ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Core · per month billed yearly ($39 a year)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on optery.com/pricing, US view, USD, monthly and yearly figures) Optery sells personal data-broker removal in four tiers. Free Basic costs nothing and needs no card: a personalised exposure report with screenshots, a scan of your Google and Bing results, and self-service removal tools, but no automated removals. Core is $3.99 a month, or $3.25 a month billed yearly ($39 a year): automated monthly removals from 380+ sites (150+ without enabling Expanded Reach), for at most one name and one city and state per user, fully automated with no human Privacy Agent. Extended is $14.99 a month, or $12.42 billed yearly ($149): 555+ sites (325+ without Expanded Reach), unlimited name variations and past cities, an assigned human Privacy Agent, removal reports with before-and-after screenshots about every 90 days, and blurring your home on Google Maps and Apple Maps. Ultimate, marked most popular, is $24.99 a month, or $20.70 billed yearly ($249): 630+ sites (405+ without Expanded Reach), unlimited custom removal requests across 945+ sites once you have been a customer for 30 days, outdated-content removal submissions to Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yahoo, and priority email support. Yearly billing saves 17%. Individual accounts have a 'No Questions Asked' 30-day money-back guarantee. On that reading a site banner offered promo code FALL2026 for 20% off at checkout, with no end date shown. Family and business plans are priced on separate pages that we did not read for this review.

compare_with.name: NordVPN
compare_with.why: NordVPN is in our dossiers too, but it hides your traffic and location while you browse; Optery removes the records data brokers already hold about you. They solve different privacy problems and are often used together.
